title: As If and I Wish: Como Si and Ojalá
goal: Compare something to an unreal situation with como si and say an unlikely wish with ojalá, both with the imperfect subjunctive.
grammar: Como si and ojalá with the imperfect subjunctive

items: I can compare something to an unreal situation with como si + imperfect subjunctive.
I can say a wish that is unlikely now with ojalá + imperfect subjunctive.
I can use the new words for pretending and joking.
